why: A November 2025 arXiv paper by Letzter, Pokrovskiy and Williams proves an asymptotic version of the conjecture (gracesize of every sufficiently large tree is at least (1-ε)n), a bound on the problem's own quantity; one source notes the key matching lemma as written does not fully verify, so the claim may not be settled as stated. The full conjecture remains open.

found.title: On the gracesize of trees
found.note: Preprint proving every sufficiently large tree has gracesize at least (1-ε)n, an asymptotic approximation to the graceful tree conjecture; not read, and one summary flags a gap in the key matching lemma.
